40021678.author: पदार्थः
40021678.content: विसृज्य having dismissed, तु indeed, सुहृद्वर्गम् the group of friends, बुद्ध्या with his intellect, निश्चित्य having resolved, राघवः Rama, समीपे nearby, द्वाःस्थम् the doorkeeper, आसीनम् seated, इदम् this, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् he spoke.

40021678.author: Translation
40021678.content: Having dismissed his group of friends and having resolved with his intellect, Rama then spoke these words to the doorkeeper who was seated nearby.

40021679.author: पदार्थः
40021679.content: शीघ्रम् quickly, आनय bring, सौमित्रिं Saumitri, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, शुभलक्षणम् endowed with auspicious marks, भरतं Bharata, च and, महाभागं the highly fortunate one, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, अपराजितम् the unconquered

40021679.author: Translation
40021679.content: Bring quickly Lakshmana, the son of Sumitra and one with auspicious marks, and also Bharata, the highly fortunate one, and Shatrughna, the unconquered.

40021680.author: पदार्थः
40021680.content: रामस्य Rama's, वचनं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, द्वाःस्थो the doorkeeper, मूर्ध्नि on his head, कृताञ्जलिः having made an anjali, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, गृहं house, गत्वा having gone, प्रविवेश entered, अनिवारितः unhindered

40021680.author: Translation
40021680.content: Having heard Rama's command, the doorkeeper, with folded hands placed on his head, went to Lakshmana's house and entered unhindered.

40021681.author: पदार्थः
40021681.content: उवाच he said, सुमहात्मानं to the great-souled one, वर्धयित्वा having greeted, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छति wishes, राजा the king, त्वां you, गम्यतां you should go, तत्र there, मा not, चिरम् delay

40021681.author: Translation
40021681.content: With folded hands, he greeted the great-souled Lakshmana and said, 'The king wishes to see you; go there without delay.'

40021682.author: पदार्थः
40021682.content: बाढम् 'Alright', इति thus, एव indeed, सौमित्रिः Saumitri, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवशासनम् Rama's command, प्राद्रवत् he hastened, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य having ascended, राघवस्य Rama's, निवेशनम् abode

40021682.author: Translation
40021682.content: Having heard Rama's command, Saumitri (Lakshmana) immediately said 'Alright' and hastened to Rama's abode, having mounted his chariot.

40021683.author: पदार्थः
40021683.content: प्रयान्तं departing, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा having seen, द्वाःस्थो the doorkeeper, भरतम् Bharata, अन्तिकात् from nearby, उवाच he said, भरतं to Bharata, तत्र there, वर्धयित्वा having greeted, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands

40021683.author: Translation
40021683.content: Having seen Lakshmana departing, the doorkeeper, from nearby, then greeted Bharata with folded hands and spoke to him.

40021684.author: पदार्थः
40021684.content: विनयावनतः humbly bowed, भूत्वा having become, राजा the king, त्वां you, द्रष्टुमिच्छति wishes to see. भरतस्तु But Bharata, वचःश्रुत्वा having heard the words, द्वाःस्थात् from the doorkeeper, रामसमीरितम् spoken by Rama.

40021684.author: Translation
40021684.content: The doorkeeper informed Bharata that the king, having become humble, wished to see him, and Bharata heard these words spoken by Rama through the doorkeeper.

40021685.author: पदार्थः
40021685.content: उत्पपात sprang up, आसनात् from his seat, तूर्णं quickly, पद्भ्यामेव by his feet alone, ययौ went, बली the mighty one (Bharata). दृष्ट्वा Having seen, प्रयान्तं going, भरतं Bharata, त्वरमाणः hurrying, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands (the doorkeeper).

40021685.author: Translation
40021685.content: The mighty Bharata quickly sprang from his seat and went on foot, while the doorkeeper, seeing Bharata depart, hurried along with folded hands.

40021686.author: पदार्थः
40021686.content: शत्रुघ्नभवनं to Shatrughna's abode, गत्वा having gone, ततो then, वाक्यमुवाच spoke words, ह indeed. एह्यागच्छ Come, come, रघुश्रेष्ठ O best of Raghus, राजा the king, त्वां you, द्रष्टुमिच्छति wishes to see.

40021686.author: Translation
40021686.content: The doorkeeper then went to Shatrughna's abode and spoke, saying, "Come, O best of Raghus, the king wishes to see you."

40021687.author: पदार्थः
40021687.content: गतो has gone, हि indeed, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, पूर्वं previously, भरतश्च and Bharata, महायशाः the greatly renowned. श्रुत्वा Having heard, तु but, वचनं the words, तस्य of him (the doorkeeper), शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, परमासनात् from his excellent seat.

40021687.author: Translation
40021687.content: The doorkeeper also informed Shatrughna that Lakshmana had already gone, and the greatly renowned Bharata too, and upon hearing these words, Shatrughna rose from his excellent seat.

40021688.author: पदार्थः
40021688.content: शिरसा with his head, धरणीं the ground, प्राप्य having touched, प्रययौ went, यत्र where, राघवः Rama. द्वाःस्थस्तु But the doorkeeper, आगम्य having come, रामाय to Rama, सर्वान् एव all of them indeed, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, निवेदयामास reported, तदा then, भ्रातॄन् his brothers, स्वान् his own, समुपस्थितान् having arrived.

40021688.author: Translation
40021688.content: Shatrughna, having bowed his head to the ground, went to where Rama was, and then the doorkeeper, with folded hands, reported to Rama that all his brothers had arrived.

40021689.author: पदार्थः
40021689.content: कुमारानागतान् the princes arrived, श्रुत्वा having heard, चिन्ताव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः whose senses were agitated by worry, अवाङ्मुखः with a downcast face, दीनमनाः distressed in mind, द्वाःस्थम् to the doorkeeper, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40021689.author: Translation
40021689.content: Having heard that the princes had arrived, Rama, with his senses agitated by worry, a downcast face, and a distressed mind, spoke to the doorkeeper.

40021690.author: पदार्थः
40021690.content: प्रवेशय make them enter, कुमारान् the princes, त्वम् you, मत्समीपम् to my presence, त्वरान्वितः quickly, एतेषु in these, जीवितम् life, मह्यम् is mine, एते these, प्राणाः vital airs, प्रियाः dear, मम to me.

40021690.author: Translation
40021690.content: "You, quickly usher the princes into my presence, for my life is in them, and these are my dear vital breaths."

40021691.author: पदार्थः
40021691.content: आज्ञप्ताः commanded, तु indeed, नरेन्द्रेण by the king, कुमाराः the princes, शक्रतेजसः having the splendor of Indra, प्रह्वाः bowed down, प्राञ्जलयः with folded hands, भूत्वा having become, विविशुः entered, ते they, समाहिताः composed.

40021691.author: Translation
40021691.content: Commanded by the king, the princes, who possessed the splendor of Indra, entered composedly, having bowed down with folded hands.

40021692.author: पदार्थः
40021692.content: ते they, तु indeed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मुखम् the face, तस्य his, सग्रहम् eclipsed, शशिनम् the moon, यथा like, सन्ध्यागतम् set in the evening, इव like, आदित्यम् the sun, प्रभया by splendor, परिवर्जितम् devoid of.

40021692.author: Translation
40021692.content: They, having seen his face, which was like the moon eclipsed or the sun at dusk devoid of its splendor, were struck by his sorrowful appearance.

40021693.author: पदार्थः
40021693.content: बाष्पपूर्णे full of tears, च and, नयने eyes, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रामस्य of Rama, धीमतः the wise, हतशोभम् lost its beauty, यथा like, पद्मम् a lotus, मुखम् the face, वीक्ष्य having seen, च and, तस्य his, ते they.

40021693.author: Translation
40021693.content: And having seen the wise Rama's eyes full of tears, and his face, which was like a lotus that had lost its beauty, they were deeply affected.

40021694.author: पदार्थः
40021694.content: ततः then, अभिवाद्य having saluted, त्वरिताः swiftly, पादौ the feet, रामस्य of Rama, मूर्धभिः with their heads, तस्थुः they stood, समाहिताः attentive, सर्वे all, रामः Rama, तु indeed, अश्रूणि tears, अवर्तयत् shed.

40021694.author: Translation
40021694.content: After swiftly saluting Rama's feet with their heads, all of them stood attentively, while Rama, in turn, shed tears.

40021695.author: पदार्थः
40021695.content: तान् them, परिष्वज्य having embraced, बाहुभ्याम् with his two arms, उत्थाप्य having raised up, च and, महाबलः the mighty one, आसनेषु on the seats, आसत sit, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, ततः then, वाक्यम् a speech, जगाद spoke, ह indeed.

40021695.author: Translation
40021695.content: The mighty Rama, embracing them with his arms and raising them up, asked them to sit on their seats, and then he spoke these words.

40021696.author: पदार्थः
40021696.content: भवन्तः you, मम my, सर्वस्वम् all, भवन्तः you, जीवितम् life, मम my, भवद्भिः by you, च and, कृतम् established, राज्यम् kingdom, पालयामि I rule, नरेश्वराः O kings.

40021696.author: Translation
40021696.content: Rama declared to the kings that they were his everything and his very life, and that he ruled the kingdom which they had helped establish.

40021697.author: पदार्थः
40021697.content: भवन्तः you, कृतशास्त्रार्थाः learned in scriptures, बुद्ध्या by intellect, च and, परिनिष्ठिताः perfected, सम्भूय having assembled, च and, मदर्थः my purpose, अयम् this, अन्वेष्टव्यः should be investigated, नरेश्वराः O kings.

40021697.author: Translation
40021697.content: Rama further stated that since they were learned in scriptures and perfected in intellect, they should all together investigate this matter of his.

40021698.author: पदार्थः
40021698.content: तथा thus, वदति while speaking, काकुत्स्थे by Kakutstha, अवधानपरायणाः very attentive, उद्विग्नमनसः with agitated minds, सर्वे all, किम् what, नु indeed, राजा the king, अभिधास्यति will say.

40021698.author: Translation
40021698.content: As Rama spoke thus, all the kings, though very attentive, became anxious in their minds, wondering what the king would say next. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुश्चत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 44 ।। Thus ends the forty-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
